name: Intuitive Surgical
tagline: Robotic surgery leader with razor-and-blade economics.
strengths: Installed base of da Vinci systems
Recurring revenue from instruments and service
weaknesses: Competition from Medtronic and J&J robots
moat: Switching costs: surgeons train on da Vinci and hospitals build programs around it. Very durable.
outlook: A high-quality compounder that has pulled back meaningfully. Still not cheap on earnings, so build gradually.
method: Quick screen, not a full analysis: moat, red flags, headline ratios and relative valuation.
